CustomMetadata.label: Proactive Renwl Incentive Status Inst MO

values.value: The Incentive Status will be set to either Pending Qualification or Does not Qualify upon save. A Status of Pending Qualification will trigger the Sales Incentive Confirmation process. The Status will remain as Pending Qualification until final sign-off is received and verification of the 75% Medical Membership Retention is complete. The most common reasons for the Incentive Status to be set to Does not Qualify include (1) Prior Year Proactive Renewal Activity, (2) Competitive bidding with other Carriers; (3) Retention of medical members <75%. If you have any questions, please contact the Incentive Compensation Team.
